title: A review's parked draft is filed with a check, so backlog.py check has no error and the land e2e test stays green
goal: Found in the SP-d3hybrlv review: the orchestrator parked a gap with backlog.py new story and no --check; new only said 'to fill in: checks missing', but backlog.py check counted it an error, and tests.py's land e2e scenario, which clones the working tree, failed on that gate. kb-sprint review step 5 and backlog.md say a parked draft carries a check (or new refuses a story without one outside a planning context), so the review's own checks stay green.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();r=t.split('## review SP')[1].split('## close SP')[0];ok='--check' in r;print('parked draft check:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 12 of 13, "Planning rules 2: plan-time warnings and probes"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F3: a sprint review files its gaps as parked drafts.
